title: Renormalised two-point functions of CLE$_4$ gaskets
summary: We first consider nested CLE$_4$ in a simply-connected domain and compute some exact renormalised probabilities: the probability that two points belong to the same CLE$_4$ gasket and the probability that two points belong to the outermost CLE$_4$ gasket. The resulting conformally covariant formulas have a non-trivial modular dependence, expressed explicitly in terms of Jacobi theta functions.
